resources.string: Scanner not available (Google Play services). Scan the QR code with the camera app or enter the details manually.
In the web interface, go to Settings → Install the app → Step 2, tap “Connect new device” and scan the QR code here.
Only confirm if this is your address. Otherwise a stranger\'s server would receive everything you enter in the app.
This isn\'t a QR code for connecting Rezeptplaner.
The address must start with https://, e.g. https://rezepte.example.org.
The API key is invalid (it starts with rp_).
Cloudflare Access needs both Client ID and Client Secret.
